nodes.description: Privileged owner address; gates init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate via msg.sender == owner checks.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances read/written by transferFrom and approve.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Minimum sale amount used by condition to gate transfers.
Maximum sale amount used by condition to gate transfers.
Sale count limit read by condition to gate transfers.
Whitelist mapping checked by ensure to bypass sale restrictions.
Whitelisted trade address read by ensure and written by setTradeAddress.
Total token supply initialized in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as _from.
Public payable transfer performing allowance checks, ensure() gating and raw balance arithmetic.
Public payable approve writing allowance for msg.sender.
Internal view whitelist gate that returns true for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale addresses else calls condition.
Internal view sale-limit validator reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Public payable function performing arbitrary delegatecall on attacker-supplied address after owner check.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution loop with unchecked balance arithmetic and duplicated Transfer events.
Owner-only setter of tradeAddress.
Deployer constructor minting supply, setting owner to msg.sender and approving UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and as transfer source.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary code in contract context.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without overflow protection in transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transfer.
Transfer amount parameter shared by transfer and transferFrom.
Source address parameter of transferFrom used for allowance and balance checks.
Computed total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend with potential overflow.
Computed Uniswap pair address cached in ensure for whitelist comparison.
Address parameter written to tradeAddress in setTradeAddress.
Unchecked multiplication, subtraction and addition on balances inside batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed directly as _from to transferFrom, bypassing the allowance check.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate authorization depends solely on msg.sender == owner.
delegate invokes the arbitrary delegatecall operation.
Caller-supplied address argument flows into the delegatecall target.
init is guarded only by msg.sender == owner.
batchSend is guarded only by msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress is guarded only by msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns owner from msg.sender at deployment.
owner state variable is initialized from msg.sender in the constructor.
transferFrom decrements allowance with unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom increments recipient balance with unchecked addition.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure reads tradeAddress for whitelist comparison.
ensure short-circuits when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure short-circuits when canSale[_from] is true.
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address sale limit.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the sale limit.
init writes _minSale derived from the token argument.
init writes _maxSale derived from the maxToken argument.
init writes _saleNum.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
batchSend mutates balanceOf entries in a loop without overflow checks.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication, subtraction and addition on balances.
The computed pair address _UNI is used as a whitelist candidate in ensure.
transfer destination parameter flows into the forwarded transferFrom call.
transfer value parameter flows into the forwarded transferFrom call.
transfer amount parameter drives allowance and balance arithmetic.
_from parameter decides whose allowance and balance are affected.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
local total = _value * _tos.length can overflow before the balance check.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf entries.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping of msg.sender.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
transfer uses msg.sender as the implicit source of the transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination address parameter is only meaningful as an argument of transfer.
Transfer amount parameter is consumed by the transferFrom balance and allowance arithmetic.
Source address parameter is only used to index allowance and balanceOf inside transferFrom.
Local total is computed and checked exclusively inside batchSend.
Local _UNI pair address is derived and used only for the whitelist check in ensure.
addr parameter exists solely to be written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
